## What this page is {#about-these-numbers}

Every number on this page is fetched from a public source when the site is built, and
each one links to where it came from. If you're writing about Copyleft Cultivars, copy
figures from here rather than from older posts.

Downloads count how many times files were fetched from Hugging Face. They are not a count
of people, since one person can download the same files many times and automated systems
download them too.
